entries.2338f7ecf5ffbe92: An anesthesia-related product, this is a pressurized drug injector connected to catheters and other devices to continuously administer small amounts of local anesthetics and analgesics. Main products are the “Syringe Jector,” which uses atmospheric pressure; the “Balloon Jector,” which uses the contractile force of a balloon; PCA devices; and the “Eimī” infusion pump. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,317 million.
entries.24f6987e7cc63e80: An anesthesia-related product, this is a medical electrical device used to continuously administer extremely small amounts of drug solution under precise control. Main products are syringe pumps and infusion pumps, used in operating rooms, intensive care units and other settings. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥190 million.

entries.a2347b6cba17785e: A product related to hospital infection prevention, this is a non-electric vacuum suction device that uses medical piping equipment as its suction source and aspirates body fluids and drainage such as blood, tissue fluid and saliva.
entries.a3d913e5e263b9da: Single-segment business that plans, develops, manufactures and sells medical devices for anesthesia and hospital infection prevention. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,290 million. Products are classified into five product groups: suction-related, injector-related, electric pump-related, handwashing facility-related and other. Research and development and production are conducted at the Product Development Research Institute and the Izumi Assembly Center, both in Izumi, Osaka Prefecture.
